subject: MercuryHold RFI: software assurance (vulnerability management) — evidence and timelines
messages:
From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@mercuryhold.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: procurement@mercuryhold.com
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2027 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: MercuryHold RFI — Software Assurance (Vulnerability Management)

Hi Stephanie and Ben,

Thanks for taking our RFI. As part of our procurement packet we need specific operational evidence around vulnerability management for Redwood's inference platform. Please provide details only for the VM section — the rest of our RFP will follow separately. Key items we need:

- SAST: tooling used, scan cadence, ruleset management, false-positive handling, and sample report output.
- DAST: scope of runtime scanning, frequency for production and pre-prod, authenticated scanning approach.
- Patch SLAs: time-to-patch commitments by severity (Critical/High/Medium/Low) and the exception/mitigation process for customer-impacting patches.
- Pen test summaries: most recent third-party engagement summary (high-level findings and remediation status).
- SBOM and provenance: format (CycloneDX/SPDX), component-level hashes and how you validate upstream artifacts; indicate where we can download the SBOM.

We would like to receive the VM evidence within 10 business days (requested delivery by 2027-06-21). Please include attachments or links and a contact for follow-up technical Q&A.

Appreciate it — cc'ing our security operations team.

Best,
Daniel Park
Senior Procurement Manager
MercuryHold

Hi Daniel / Stephanie,

Following up with the technical VM evidence. I've attached a compact packet and included links for the SBOM/provenance. Key points summarized below; see attachments for sample reports and a short CSV mapping of SLA targets.

SAST
- Tooling: We run a combination of static analyzers: Semgrep for rule-driven checks and a commercial scanner (Fortify) for deep AST on compiled artifacts.
- Cadence: Nightly SAST on main + PR gates for all pull requests. Weekly full-codebase scans (nightly incremental reports stored).
- Ruleset & triage: Centralized ruleset maintained in our SCM; security team reviews rule updates monthly. We maintain a triage backlog in Jira (linked in artifact).
- Sample: Attached 'sast_sample_report.html' (redacted findings).

DAST / Runtime Testing
- Scope: Authenticated scanning against staging/pre-prod; selective authenticated checks in production (non-intrusive).
- Frequency: Quarterly full DAST runs + pre-release DAST for major releases (>10% service change). We also run targeted smoke scans after infrastructure changes.
- Approach: We use OWASP ZAP with authenticated session replay and scriptable auth flows; dynamic scans are integrated into our pre-prod pipeline.

Patch SLAs
- SLA commitments (standard): Critical: 30 business days (patch + customer rollout plan); High: 60 business days; Medium: 180 business days; Low: 365 business days or vendor cadence.
- Emergency process: For 0-day/actively exploited CVEs we commit to a 72-hour mitigation plan (workaround/fallover + communication) while a permanent patch is prioritized.
- Exceptions: Any SLA exceptions are documented and require customer notification and a compensating control. The attached 'patch_sla_matrix.csv' lists examples and mitigation steps.

Pen Test
- Last third-party pen test: April 2027 (summary attached: 'pen_test_summary_202704.pdf'). High-level: two medium findings and several low items; all high/medium findings have fixes deployed and verified (retest comments in the PDF). We can provide the full engagement report under NDA.

SBOM & Provenance
- Format: We produce CycloneDX (JSON) and SPDX (tag-value) exports.
- Component hashes: We include SHA-256 hashes for direct dependencies and record source repositories when available.
- Provenance: We maintain a build provenance record (CI artifact metadata) that links source commit -> binary -> container image digest. The SBOM bundle is in the Drive folder below.
- Download: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cRedwood-SBOM-2027 (read-only link shared).

Attachments included in this send: 'redwood_sbom_202706.zip', 'pen_test_summary_202704.pdf', 'patch_sla_matrix.csv', 'sast_sample_report.html'.

If you want, we can provide a short walk-through doc and a pivot table of vulnerability age/backlog stats prior to the call.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Security — Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.inference.com

Rishi — thanks for the quick and thorough response. A couple clarifying items before our call on 06/13: 

1) CVE backlog and ageing: can you provide current counts by severity (Critical/High/Medium) and the oldest open critical/backlog age? We want a snapshot in the SBOM/backlog export or an attached pivot.
2) Pen test retest: for the April 2027 engagement — did the vendor verify remediation with retest, or were fixes verified internally? We may request the vendor attestation under NDA.
3) SBOM detail: is the CycloneDX bundle component-level (top-level + transitive) with hashes for transitive dependencies, or only direct dependencies? Also confirm whether the SBOM includes PURL identifiers.

If you can attach that pivot or a short CSV before the call that would be perfect. Also please confirm the link permission for the SBOM folder so our SecOps can download it.

Best,
Daniel Park
